exposure: Insurance status (Lebanon: three classes; US: insured vs. non-insured)
outcome: Cost of common gynecologic procedures in US dollars
cohort: 505 patients in Lebanon and an unspecified number of patients in the United States
finding: The study found that the cost of common gynecologic procedures (cesarean delivery, hysterectomy, laparoscopic myomectomy) was significantly higher in the United States compared to Lebanon, regardless of insurance status.
mod_finding: The cost of Cesarean delivery was significantly higher in the United States compared to Lebanon, even when patients were classified according to their insurance status.
